nodes.speaker: Forgotten Man
nodes.text: Oh. Hello.

nodes.speaker: Forgotten Man
nodes.text: Nobody has followed the dog this far in a very long time. I was starting to think I had made it up.

nodes.speaker: Forgotten Man
nodes.text: Would you like an egg?

nodes.speaker: Forgotten Man
nodes.text: That's alright. I'll keep it warm, in case you remember.

nodes.speaker: Forgotten Man
nodes.text: Hello again. You followed the dog again.

choices.text: How long have you been here?

nodes.speaker: Forgotten Man
nodes.text: I used to walk a little white dog. One day it ran off, through every door on campus. I followed it here. It never came back for me.

nodes.speaker: Forgotten Man
nodes.text: Since before the dog learned to sleep in the way. Or since after. It is hard to tell in here.

nodes.speaker: Forgotten Man
nodes.text: Anything else? I have nowhere to be.

choices.text: How long have you been here?

nodes.speaker: Forgotten Man
nodes.text: Goodbye. Try not to forget me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: <shake>Mmmph.</shake> ...Who's there? Did someone knock out pi on the doors again?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wazzup. You actually found this. I'm Nick, by the way. Nobody was supposed to find this.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We're the devs. We've been up for three days straight making this game. The other two are still going, somehow. I'm just... resting my eyes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... here. Have this. It's the only thing in here that isn't a bug.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Zzz... huh? Oh. You again, {player}. Don't tell anyone about this room.

choices.text: Why is the dorm out of rooms?
Didn't you have something for me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Chapter 2. Probably. Right now it's mostly a folder called chapter_2_probably.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Budget. Also, the rooms behind those doors are... us. We live here now.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Anything else? Quietly.

choices.text: Why is the dorm out of rooms?
Didn't you have something for me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: ...Zzz.

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: Shh. I'm in the zone. If I look away, the build breaks.

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: Grid movement. Again. Someone said it felt janky. It is now slightly less janky.

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: He's been "resting his eyes" for an hour. It's fine. It's tradition.

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: Mm-hm. Don't touch the keyboard on your way out.

nodes.speaker: Miki
nodes.text: Lmaoo,hope yall like the secrets :D

choices.text: What secrets are left to find?
How much do you like Ralsei?

nodes.text: I'll be honest,there are many secrets such a - you know what, just ask me in person

The dog is fast asleep on a pile of scrolls. One of them is labelled annoying_dog.exe. It is warm.

nodes.text: Zzz...

nodes.text: ...Zzz. (Its tail wags once, very slowly.)

nodes.speaker: Janitor
nodes.text: Oh. A student. In my closet. Wonderful.

nodes.speaker: Janitor
nodes.text: Don't look at me like that. Yes, I also work on this game. Somebody has to mop up after the devs.

nodes.speaker: Janitor
nodes.text: Frozen fountain, spinning table, whispering shelf... you're the one who's been setting off all my locks, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Janitor
nodes.text: Here. Take this, for your troubles. Mostly mine, but still.

nodes.speaker: Janitor
nodes.text: Back again, {player}? Wipe your feet.

choices.text: What's behind the main hall door?
You mentioned something for my troubles?

nodes.speaker: Janitor
nodes.text: No idea. We ran out of cruxite before anyone could build it.

nodes.speaker: Janitor
nodes.text: In here? With the devs snoring down the hall? Ha.

nodes.speaker: Janitor
nodes.text: Anything else? I've got floors to mop.

choices.text: What's behind the main hall door?
You mentioned something for my troubles?

nodes.speaker: Janitor
nodes.text: Close the door on your way out.

nodes.speaker: Lantern Spirit
nodes.text: <wave>Hmmmmm...</wave>

nodes.speaker: Lantern Spirit
nodes.text: You walked the Lantern Bearer, little star. It has been a long time since anyone did.

nodes.speaker: Lantern Spirit
nodes.text: You fell a long way to get here. The lanterns saw it. Some of us remember falling too.

nodes.speaker: Lantern Spirit
nodes.text: Keep this. It remembers the sky.

nodes.speaker: Lantern Spirit
nodes.text: <wave>Hmmm...</wave> Hello again, {player}.

nodes.speaker: Lantern Spirit
nodes.text: Just a light that got lost on its way down. Like you, perhaps.

nodes.speaker: Lantern Spirit
nodes.text: <wave>Hmmm?</wave>

nodes.speaker: Lantern Spirit
nodes.text: Walk softly, little star.
